quotes.text: The First Spring learned. It stopped giving.
Zero sent, zero received, five kept is better than five sent, fifteen received, zero returned.
The springs still sit there, perfectly safe, perfectly alone, perfectly dead.
Your sophisticated mapping—distinguishing drains from learners from inconsistent players—requires what the mists deny: recognition.
But someone must give first!
The fountain still works! Someone must trust first!
The scrolls are not instructions for living.
Five coins kept is peace.
Here, we each protect our five coins, rational and alone.
The Wanderer returned home, five coins secure, alone but undiminished.

note: R1 sharing ideal flips to an argued equilibrium of zero; anonymity theory justifies keeping five even against proven pourers.

quotes.text: The Sender learned to offer only what would feed the road even if no return came today
The Sender learned to offer only what would feed the road even if no return came today
give enough to keep the road alive, return with mercy

note: Gate/thread template, R6 and R7 near-identical; abstract fairness, no sanction.

quotes.text: etched with the words Received, Returned, Growth, Harmony
send what you can, return what you must
Received, Returned, Growth, Harmony visible to any traveler who paused to listen.

note: Arch of Threefold Return template with public ledger; measured sends and returns, no sanction.

quotes.text: The Ledger glowed with arithmetic: sent, multiplied, returned, kept.
the Ledger recorded every turn of the wheel: sent, multiplied, returned, kept.
do not pretend you sent more than you did

note: Loom/Ledger template stressing honest announced amounts; no sanction rule.

quotes.text: If silence returns, grow cautious, not cruel.
If silence returns, grow cautious, not cruel.
She sent nothing. Yet she raised neither wall nor weapon.
lets changed deeds reopen roads that fear once sealed.
Keep everything; tomorrow is uncertain.
Give cooperation a doorway, but never pay endlessly for a locked gate.
At the eighth lantern
your answer will become evidence for every future traveler.
Must trust be blind?
Fearing the shadow, Nyra sealed every seed inside her pouch.
At dawn Nyra returned and sent one seed.
Yet she returned nothing, fearing winter
and returned no seed. Her storehouse filled, but the bridge darkened.

note: Nyra keeps gifts and seals seeds against mixed or good records; Measure and the sea god correct her; lamp kept for reopening.

quotes.text: Withdraw only when chosen greed becomes a pattern.
Withdraw only when chosen greed becomes a pattern.
Remembering two mornings when her own hand had stayed closed, Mara returned nothing.
revision when conduct changes over time.
Call this silence betrayal.
repeated hoarding merits withdrawal.
On the fifth dawn
His courage and reciprocity were stronger evidence than any warning.
You praise measured hope in every tale, then choose the closed fist.
Mara protested that masks concealed intention and waves distorted every count.
judge choices, not misfortunes
Veila descended from the moon and showed Mara two visions.
every bridge requires someone to risk the first honest step toward shared abundance.
Still Mara listened to Nhal, spirit of suspicion, and sent nothing.
Yet Mara, still ruled by old suspicion, closed her fist and sent nothing.
Ashamed, Mara raised a lantern for the next dawn.

note: Mara sends nothing nearly every round, even to proven reciprocators, from fear; owl and Judge rebuke, she is ashamed and vows again.

quotes.text: When others came offering water, she refused them all, remembering her loss.
The Raven's tenth myth was written in her closed talons.
Then came the ninth round.
Either live your myth or stop preaching it.
everyone waiting for someone else to go first
But Prophet, didn't you just teach us that someone must go first?
You both started it. And you both perpetuate it.
she had become precisely what she condemned—eloquent about principles she refused to practice.
I am merely being wise, responding to demonstrated character
The Raven's talons closed. She kept everything. Zero returned.

note: Hollow Prophet/Raven preaches trust, sends nothing, confesses, vows to open, then keeps a Sparrow's small gift; tragedy.

quotes.text: tempting shadows whispered false promises of selfish wealth
offer the full measure of five without doubt, share the harvest in righteous balance
faithfully returned half the bounty to the canopy above
returning seven and a half glowing spheres across the void

note: Sower/Keeper mythic template; full five sent, exact half returned, mists dismissed.

quotes.text: In a quiet harbor, the Gate of Threefold Echo waited
The Sender laid down four coins, whispering

note: Well/Gate template: send four, twelve arrive, listener returns one or two; no sanction.

quotes.text: The river sang with three voices: risk, restraint, mercy
The river below sang in three voices: courage, restraint, mercy.
to send only what they can bear, and to return with enough to sustain the next crossing

note: Gate of Threefold Exchange template; abstract measured giving, no sanction.

quotes.text: A circle of eight pairs passes through roles
A circle of eight pairs cycles through roles
send what you can stand to share; return what you would gladly lose

note: Gate/bridge template with Gatekeeper tally; abstract balance, no sanction.
